organizations.normalization_notes: The source calls the agency the Works Progress Administration. That historical form is preserved even though the agency was renamed the Work Projects Administration in 1939.
Army service is modeled as a military assignment, not civilian employment.

affiliations.date_precision: The institutional biography dates participation to 1936-1942; Brooks's oral history describes paid WPA mural work and says he left as the project was ending before Army induction.
affiliations.research_notes: The direct oral history describes paid work on WPA murals and leaving the project before Civil Pilot Training and Army induction. No later civilian employer before military service was identified.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record supplies the induction date. Brooks's oral history directly sequences Army assignments, Camp Dix, and several months in the OSS Presentation Department; the exact OSS start date is not stated.
affiliations.research_notes: Modeled as military assignment, not employment. The oral history gives a direct Army-to-OSS sequence but not a formal transfer order or exact date.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 039 on July 31, 1943; the category supplies neither a profession nor an employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The broad residual occupation code cannot support a named profession, employer, or immediate OSS predecessor.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 992 on February 15, 1943; the official code table identifies students but names no institution.
affiliations.research_notes: Student status is not employment. The school and Army-to-OSS chronology remain unknown.

claims.claim_text: The indexed James D. Brooks is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match and as the artist whose direct oral history describes Army and OSS service.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and official Army file match on full name and private identifier; the Smithsonian chronology independently matches Army and OSS art work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier, exact normalized full name, and a highly specific Army-to-OSS artistic-service chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record begins September 17, 1942; the oral history describes wartime Army assignments followed by OSS Presentation Department work.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is withheld. The combined official and Smithsonian evidence distinguishes this person from other James Brooks namesakes.
